race.description: Carlton United Brewery Country Boosted Mdn Hcp
race.comment: SYLLABLE (8) returned last time with a solid second at this track over 1200m after being in the firing line on the corner. Will have come on with that run now under the belt and is sure to prove very hard to toss in this suitable race. MONGOLIAN MASTER (1) has been right there in all three runs this preparation and looks to be working up to a maiden victory. Looms as the main danger. UNALIENABLE RIGHT (2) finished second, beaten 0.7 lengths, when resuming from a spell last start over 1000m at Tuncurry after he was prominent at the corner. Placed to advantage so expect another big run. BUCKO'S WISH (10) was out of the money on debut two runs back then just missed the frame last start when she got a long way back over 1100m at Armidale, beaten 1.5 lengths into fifth. Finds a nice race and can feature in the finish.
